final: WITH g AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.dealedge AS side, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge), s AS (SELECT side, AVG(avg_net) AS side_avg FROM g GROUP BY side) SELECT g.orderslink, g.side, g.avg_net, g.cnt, g.avg_net - s.side_avg AS diff FROM g JOIN s ON g.side IS s.side WHERE g.avg_net > s.side_avg ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
